name: CULLSIZE-the-born-radius-only
note: the base: the sphere keeps the radius the batch was born with - the street's foe culled on its { w: 1, h: 1 } placeholder, the cart's horse on its still picture

name: CULLSIZE-reach-never-grows
old: return q > r * r * (1 + 1e-6) ? Math.sqrt(q) : r;
note: batchReach answers the stored radius whatever the size drawn

name: CULLSIZE-no-hair
note: an unchanged batch whose float32 radius rounded down is handed the double's - its sphere no longer bit for bit what it was born with

name: CULLSIZE-always-the-drawn-size
note: the reach is the drawn size's alone: a pixel's wood loses its placements' spread, a flat drawn smaller shrinks its sphere

name: CULLSIZE-half-diagonal-doubled
note: the square of the half-diagonal taken at a half, not a quarter - every flat grows past what it draws

name: CULLSIZE-half-diagonal-short
note: the reach falls short of the quad's corners

name: CULLSIZE-width-forgotten
note: the height alone - a square sprite's corners left outside

name: CULLSIZE-no-size-no-reach
note: a batch with no size loses its stored radius
